The present petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing of entire criminal prosecution and proceeding including order dated 02.08.13, passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar in connection with C.G. Case No. 4/13, whereby the cognizance has been taken under section 3 (zz), (viii), (ix) read with Section 26 and 27 of the Food Safety and standards Act, 2006, which is punishable under Section 59 (ii) of the said Act, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar.

The learned counsel for the petitioner by referring page-16, which is part of the Annexure-1, pointed out that the Analysis report in Form No.VIIA bearing No. 95/FSSA/2013, dated 06th March, 2013,
duly signed, issued and forwarded by the Food Analyst for the State of Jharkhand with regard to the sample of 'Laddu' bearing code and Serial no. LATR-08 for information, observation and doing needful.
The said report was forwarded vide Memo No. 59, dated 04.07.2013.

In this context, the learned counsel or the petitioner by referring Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, submitted that in view of sub-section (iii) of Section 42, the designated officer after scrutiny of the report of the Food Analyst, shall sent his recommendation within 14 days to the Commissioner of Food Safety for getting sanction of prosecution.
It is submitted that in the instant case, the requirement prescribed under sub- section (iii) of Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has not been followed.

Over and above this, the learned counsel for the petitioner by referring sub-section (iii) of Section 46 of the Act, pointed out that the requirement prescribed under law has not been followed in the instant case and no such report has been given to the petitioner.

The learned A.P.P. appearing for the State prayed for four weeks' time to take instructions and file Manish Kumar Gupta vs The State Of Jharkhand on 10 December, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149588298/
1 counter affidavit.
